_comment: Per-90 rates as the feed carried them BEFORE gameweek 1 — i.e. last season's 38-game sample. Once the season starts the live bootstrap overwrites these fields with current-season rates over a 1-2 game sample, which is noise (De Cuyper projected 11.97 xPts off one goal). core/fpl_priors blends this history with the live sample by minutes. Captured 2026-08-19, never regenerated.
